changelog: Profile: Change Password and its editor are gone — 4.7.69 removed password sign-in, so there was no password left to change and the handoff has no Security section.

Name is editable again (D_2.5): the row gets a chevron and opens a Name screen with a Save that stays dim until the value changes; it writes the nickname and falls back to the registered account when none is set.
Linked Email shows the full address. /user/select/iotUserInfo returns it masked, so the value from sign-in is preferred when the server's is masked.
